referenceIdentityNote: Identity supplied by founder in EP6-P5E-R Phase 4B authorization (2026-08-12). Phase 4A incorrectly attributed Ani to 'Parfums de Marly'. Phase 4C-1 research independently confirms the reference fragrance is 'Ani' by Nishane — a 2019 unisex Extrait de Parfum by the Turkish niche house Nishane. Multiple search sources confirm the fragrance exists and matches the founder-supplied identity. 'Parfums de Marly — Ani' does not exist. Identity upgraded from EXPECTED to INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED.

contradictions.description: Top note naming: 'Blue Ginger' (Listing A, ANI-F08) vs 'Ginger' (Listing B, ANI-F09). 'Blue Ginger' is a named botanical cultivar (Dichorisandra thyrsiflora). Some sources use the specific cultivar name; others use the generic. Both recordings are preserved. The distinction may be editorial rather than olfactive.
contradictions.resolution: BOTH_RECORDED — not resolved by available sources.

canonicalSummary: Ani by Nishane is a 2019 unisex Extrait de Parfum created by Cécile Zarokian for the Turkish niche house Nishane. It is classified as an Oriental Floral fragrance. Notes centre on a ginger-bergamot-pink pepper opening, a heart of Turkish rose, blackcurrant and cardamom, and a rich base of vanilla, sandalwood, benzoin, ambergris and musks. The Maison's Phase 4A identity attribution to Parfums de Marly was incorrect. The correct reference is independently verified as Nishane — Ani (2019). All findings in this dossier concern the reference fragrance only and do not constitute evidence about Maison Skye & Rose's inspired formulation.
